page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v6 is an ECadsv6-family virtual machine configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an x86_64 AMD processor. The architecture runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type includes 2458 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no dedicated GPUs present on this instance.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a memory-optimized resource. The inclusion of local SSD storage provides a consolidated hardware profile for workloads requiring high memory capacity alongside local scratch space. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive databases, large-scale enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that fit within a 512.0 GB memory footprint.
